Player cites lines 40-87 with GUARDKIT_NATS_PASSWORD read from os.environ, optional .env file support, and actionable ValueError with proper message. Tests cited: test_missing_password_raises_actionable_error, test_blank_password_raises_actionable_error.

NATSConfig/NATSClient construction verified by evidence bundle. Player cites line 79: NATSConfig with url='nats://127.0.0.1:4222', user='guardkit', password=SecretStr(password), name='guardkit-harvest'; line 87: NATSClient(config, source_id='guardkit-harvest'). Tests cited verify parameters.

Lifecycle ordering verified. Player cites line 119: await client.connect(), lines 122-131: publish loop, line 148: await client.disconnect() in finally block. Uses .disconnect() not .close(). Test test_publish_lifecycle_ordering verifies ordering via assert_has_calls().

Per-episode ValueError handling verified. Player cites lines 133-144: try/except catches ValueError from publish_episode, increments skipped_oversized, logs actionable warning with episode_id + size + 'chunk upstream' message, loop continues. Tests verify: test_oversized_episode_skipped_with_actionable_message, test_oversized_episode_does_not_abort_run.

Idempotent/resumable design verified. Player confirms no client-side deduplication state in PublishResult or publish_episodes(), all episodes published every run, JetStream deduplication via Nats-Msg-Id handled by NATSClient.publish_episode(). Test test_idempotent_deterministic_episode_ids verifies.

Full delegation to publish_episode verified. Player confirms all NATS operations delegated to NATSClient.publish_episode() at line 124, no NATS protocol code/subject construction/header setting in harvest_publisher.py. Only calls: client.connect(), client.publish_episode(episode), client.disconnect(). Code review confirms no nats.js imports or NATS wire protocol logic.

PublishResult summary verified. Player cites PublishResult dataclass (lines 25-37) with published, skipped_oversized, counts_per_type fields properly populated throughout the loop. Test test_returns_publish_summary verifies.

Mock-based unit tests verified by evidence bundle and Player's detailed citations. All tests use AsyncMock(spec=NATSClient) fixture (lines 62-68), no live broker. Tests verify lifecycle ordering, oversized skip with logging, run continuation. Player reports 50 total tests (14 publisher + 36 taxonomy) in 2.39s.
